RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 30

An all-male panel alone proves little, but it is worth noting. Many equality frameworks expect mixed panels, and together with other facts it can support a discrimination claim. The stronger point is the comparison. On paper you look better qualified: a PhD and eight years running a section, against a master's and vague "broad leadership experience." He may still have had real management experience that the criteria weighted heavily.

Don't lead with the panel's makeup. Send a firm follow-up asking for the written reasons, the selection criteria and your scores. The answer, or continued silence, will tell you much more. Check your deadline for complaints, which is often short, and talk to your union or equality body soon.
